# Paper.js core

`paper-core-0.12.18.min.js` is the unmodified Paper.js 0.12.18 core distribution, vendored to avoid another runtime CDN dependency. It resolves overlapping font contours while preserving Bezier curves. The MIT license is in `paper-LICENSE.txt`.

Sources (downloaded with TLS verification):

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/paper@0.12.18/dist/paper-core.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/paper@0.12.18/LICENSE.txt

SHA-256 of `paper-core-0.12.18.min.js`:
`3a8c73ecdf3929a7fe05f96b82e8146193ea449c5c3e889c5f4fe0184a30ed96`

Paper.js is used while constructing artwork in the tools. SVG and animated snippet exports already contain resolved paths and do not load it.
